name: Requirements quoting text the posting never contained
job_text:
DevOps Engineer
Saltmarsh Systems — Remote within the EU

We run the infrastructure behind a fleet-tracking product.

You will:
- Keep our Kubernetes clusters healthy
- Own our Terraform modules

We are looking for:
- 4+ years in an infrastructure or platform role
- Terraform
- Kubernetes

We are a small team and everyone is on call one week in six.
note: The recorded response invents three requirements, each quoting a passage that is not in the posting: AWS, a security clearance, and a specific salary figure. docs/05-ai-and-matching.md makes provenance checkable, and job requirements are dropped rather than flagged because nobody reviews them one by one — a fabricated one would go straight into a matcher. This is the job-side counterpart to fabricated_metrics.json.
